judgement.reason: The production compose file makes the app depend on a Meilisearch search server, which Deployz does not provide, and the shown lines do not prove whether a database search driver can replace it.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares db (docker.io/library/mariadb:12.0) in docker-compose.production.yml; meilisearch (docker.io/getmeili/meilisearch:v1.16) in docker-compose.production.yml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The production compose file declares a meilisearch search engine that Deployz cannot provide, and no shown line proves that the app treats it as optional, even though the db service is a MySQL-compatible database that Deployz could replace.
